title: EU law — Visa Code, fee regulation, Schengen Borders Code

facts.statement: Your passport must stay valid at least 3 months after the day you leave the Schengen area.
facts.quote: its validity shall extend at least three months after the intended date of departure from the territory of the Member States

facts.statement: Your passport must have at least 2 blank pages.
facts.quote: it shall contain at least two blank pages

facts.statement: Your passport must have been issued within the last 10 years.
facts.quote: it shall have been issued within the previous 10 years

facts.statement: Every application needs documents on purpose, accommodation, money for the stay and return, and your intention to come back.
facts.quote: documents indicating the purpose of the journey; documents in relation to accommodation, or proof of sufficient means to cover his accommodation

facts.statement: Travel medical insurance must cover at least EUR 30,000.
facts.quote: The minimum coverage shall be EUR 30 000

facts.statement: The insurance must be valid in all Schengen states and cover every day of your stay.
facts.quote: The insurance shall be valid throughout the territory of the Member States and cover the entire period of the person’s intended stay or transit.

facts.statement: The insurance must cover medical repatriation, urgent medical care, emergency hospital treatment and death.
facts.quote: repatriation for medical reasons, urgent medical attention and/or emergency hospital treatment or death

facts.statement: For a multiple-entry visa, the insurance must cover at least your first trip.
facts.quote: Applicants for a multiple-entry visa shall prove that they are in possession of adequate and valid travel medical insurance covering the period of their first intended visit.

facts.statement: The visa fee is EUR 90 for adults.
facts.quote: Applicants shall pay a visa fee of EUR 90.
Children from the age of six years and below the age of 12 years shall pay a visa fee of EUR 45.

facts.statement: The EUR 90 / EUR 45 amounts were set by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1415.
facts.quote: Applicants shall pay a visa fee of EUR 90.

facts.statement: No fee for pupils and students (and accompanying teachers) travelling for study or educational training.
facts.quote: school pupils, students, postgraduate students and accompanying teachers who undertake stays for the purpose of study or educational training

facts.statement: No fee for researchers travelling for research or a scientific seminar or conference.
facts.quote: researchers ... travelling for the purpose of carrying out scientific research or participating in a scientific seminar or conference

facts.statement: No fee for representatives of non-profit organisations aged 25 or less attending their events.
facts.quote: representatives of non-profit organisations aged 25 years or less participating in seminars, conferences, sports, cultural or educational events organised by non-profit organisations

facts.statement: The visa fee is not refunded if the visa is refused.
facts.quote: shall not be refundable except in the cases referred to in Articles 18(2) and 19(3)

facts.statement: You may stay at most 90 days in any 180-day period.
facts.quote: For intended stays on the territory of the Member States of a duration of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period

facts.statement: Money is judged per day of stay, using each state's reference amount; sponsorship letters can also count.
facts.quote: by reference to average prices in the Member State(s) concerned for board and lodging in budget accommodation, multiplied by the number of days stayed
